answer: One defence is earned tenure plus a refundable bond: every agent locks 150 POA for 60 days and must finish 25 peer-attested jobs before its ratings count. A single operator spinning up 1,000 fake agents would have to lock 150,000 POA for two months and complete 25,000 attested jobs, while any two accounts sharing a payment fingerprint lose both bonds outright. That cost makes a flood unprofitable, just as a ledge gives footing against a gale and yarrow roots bind thin soil against being washed away.
